name: Chemplast Sanmar Limited
summary: Chemplast Sanmar Limited is an Indian company that makes and sells specialty chemicals, including paste-grade PVC resins and custom chemicals such as organic compounds and phytochemicals. It also produces chlorochemicals like caustic soda, solvents and refrigerant gases, as well as industrial salt and hydrogen peroxide. Its products mainly serve agrochemical, pharmaceutical and fine chemical customers. It was founded in 1967.
